new = '''"""Offline, defensive auditor for a synthetic QUIC v1 receiver model.

Reads one UTF-8 JSON document from stdin, writes one JSON document to stdout.

The model is a finite, local re-implementation of the packet/frame boundary
policies described in the task contract.  It never parses wire packets, never
performs TLS and never touches the network.

Local policy notes (these are audit rules, not RFC claims):

* Input grammar problems (duplicate keys, unknown keys, wrong types,
  out-of-domain values, structural limit violations, malformed JSON) make the
  whole request invalid; protocol violations found while replaying a valid
  request are reported instead of invalidating the request.
* A packet is preflighted as a whole before any frame effect is applied: the
  first frame that is UNKNOWN or not permitted at the packet's encryption
  level decides the error, so a packet either applies completely or not at all.
* Frame effects of a failed packet are rolled back (delivered bytes, created
  streams, flow accounting, STOP flags and CRYPTO bytes), while packets that
  were accepted earlier stay committed.
* Byte storage is sparse so that very large offsets stay cheap; reassembly is
  independent per stream and per CRYPTO encryption level.
"""'''
assert old in s
s = s.replace(old, new)
open(p,'w').write(s)
